adaptive.root_coverage: Direct branch roots bracketed between all analytic stationary candidates. Near-zero critical values retained. Floating-point root isolation is not interval certified.
adaptive.uncertainty_scope: QUADPACK reports estimates, not bounds. The sum of outer estimates plus maximum observed inner estimate is a heuristic, not a confidence interval.

facewise.reason: This mode was run only for spinodoid and Schwarz P/D, not these four Gyroid cases.

score_comparison.mesh_volume_numerics: Saved Tet10 quadrature volumes are reused. Repetition discrepancy and float ulp are recorded separately; neither certifies quadrature roundoff. No new mesh-volume numerical audit is performed.
score_comparison.ranking_scope: Absolute volume-error improvements are compared with empirical integration discrepancy and reported heuristics. Neither is a rigorous error bound. Frozen scores and admission remain unchanged.
